verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-prevention SaaS platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only event-driven mechanisms: real-time webhooks, call-and-response evidence workflows, and MCP natural-language actions. These are one-off or event-triggered actions, not recurring schedules, and nothing documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
